messages:
meera: Quick experiment idea for next week: tighten pricing FAQ to 4Q + add a micro-calculator card under tiers. Keep lead capture optional (only when user clicks 'Talk to sales'). Goal = clearer choice architecture and fewer pricing support pings.

alex: Sounds good. For tier naming let's test two families: pragmatic (Starter / Pro / Enterprise) vs benefit-led (Build / Optimize / Scale). Only swap copy, keep prices identical.

peter: Dev note: calculator should be a small card that lazy-loads and calls /api/estimate-v1. Feature flag = pricing_microcard_v1. Events: `pricing_card:open`, `pricing_card:estimate`, `pricing_card:lead`. Routing: estimated_arr >= 35k -> sales-inbound, else -> nurture.

meera: Copy plan: 4 FAQ items, each one-liner + optional expansion. Also include a 1-sentence benchmark: "Typical 5-dev chat app ~50k-200k tokens/mo". I'll share drafts by Tue.

ops-bot: Preview deploy available: https://preview.redwood/pricing-microcard-5544332211 (flag pricing_microcard_v1).

alex: Metrics: primary = trial-start rate; secondary = calculator engagement and support tickets tagged 'pricing'. Baseline conv = 3.5%, target +0.4pp. Run 14 days at 25% traffic.

meera: Great. Launch Wed 09:00 PT behind flag. Will post quick retro doc link after 7 days. Thanks team :rocket:
